title: Power Rangers Season 10 Wild Force
description: After Cole Evans becomes the new leader of the Wild Force Power Rangers, he strives to fight against the evil forces of the Orgs.

episodes.title: S10-E39The End of the Power Rangers (1)
S10-E40The End of the Power Rangers (2)

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Wild Force 10x1
episodes_data.description: A young man raised in the jungle travels to the city of Turtle Cove and discovers an island - home to legendary beasts from an ancient civilization - floating in the sky above the city.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Wild Force 10x2
episodes_data.description: Cole seeks to reason with the Orgs while Jindrax and Toxica discover that after 3000 years the Master Org has returned to Earth again.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Wild Force 10x3
episodes_data.description: Master Org gives Toxica and Jindrax a pep talk in preparation for his next dastardly plan. Cole reads Taylor's Ranger rule book, but says there should only be one rule: teamwork.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Wild Force 10x4
episodes_data.description: Max reads the newspaper and suggests that he and Danny check out the haunted temple to see if it has an org. Danny's mind is elsewhere, though, as he has his eyes on Kendall, whom he has a crush on.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Wild Force 10x5
episodes_data.description: Alyssa starts a day at school on an archeological dig. While snooping around, she finds a glowing Wild Force emblem inside a cave. Later, she grabs Princess Shayla and Cole to help her check it out.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Wild Force 10x6
episodes_data.description: Alyssa reads a story to Max and Danny about a creature in Turtle Lake that can grant wishes. Max falls asleep and has a short dream about the megazord getting defeated.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Wild Force 10x7
episodes_data.description: When jogging, Taylor stops by at the airport and remembers when she first came to the Animarium. She then meets two boys: wearing black and white, running from a security guard.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Wild Force 10x8
episodes_data.description: The rangers learn of a magical bird called the Soul Bird in the forest that can heal the Wild Zords. Cole thinks it may be able to heal the Red Lion, so the Rangers head off to find it.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Wild Force 10x9
episodes_data.description: Master Org's old bodyguard Retinax fights the Power Rangers to restore his lost honor.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Wild Force 10x10
episodes_data.description: Master Org releases the General Org Nayzor, who finds and releases another Duke Org - Zen-Aku. Zen-Aku utterly defeats the Rangers in battle, and steals the Elephant zord from Alyssa.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Wild Force 10x11
episodes_data.description: An injured Alyssa is tended to by Zen-Aku, after she is attacked by Toxica and Jindrax. Zen-Aku summons his own Dark Wild Zords to battle the Rangers' Wild Zords.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Wild Force 10x12
episodes_data.description: After defeating the runaway Bus org, the Rangers face Zen-Aku who defeats Cole easily in a brief battle, he also combines his Dark Wild Zords into the Predazord, and steals the Giraffe Power Animal from them.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Wild Force 10x13
episodes_data.description: Zen-Aku frees Motorcycle Org, and kidnaps Princess Shayla. Shayla's necklace brings back vague memories for Zen-Aku. The Rangers battle Motorcycle Org and Zen-Aku, and get back the Princess. Taylor is defeated by Zen-Aku, who steals the Bear animal crystals.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Wild Force 10x14
episodes_data.description: As Zen-Aku begins to remember his true past, Nayzor plants a bug in his head, which convinces him that he is pure evil, making him an even more dangerous threat to the Rangers.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Wild Force 10x15
episodes_data.description: The ancient Animus intervenes to reveal Zen-Aku's true identity - Merrick, the ancient warrior who defeated Master Org by using the cursed wolf mask. By defeating the Predazord with new zords, the Rangers break the curse, returning Merrick back to normal.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Wild Force 10x16
episodes_data.description: After a failed attempt to retrieve the stolen Animal Crystals, Merrick must fight the Quadra Org, who was created with the power of the crystals. With the Rangers tied up, Merrick battles on his own, until his Wild Zords return to him and give him the power to morph into the Lunar Wolf Ranger.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Wild Force 10x17
episodes_data.description: Toxica powers herself up into the newest General Org - Necronomica. Merrick helps the Rangers defeat her with his newest vehicle - the Wolf Savage Cycle.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Wild Force 10x18
episodes_data.description: Signal Org makes Cole lose his memory. He ends up on a farm, and is eventually found by the Rangers and returned to normal just in time to defeat Signal Org. Also, Alyssa discovers that Cole's parents have been presumed dead.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Wild Force 10x19
episodes_data.description: Bowling Org makes Max learn a new bowling technique the tornado spin. To learn the move, he must convince his old bowling coach to regain his will to bowl.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Wild Force 10x20
episodes_data.description: Danny competes for Kendall's affection while the Rangers try to find Wedding Dress Org and his captives. Kendall discovers that Danny is the Black Ranger, and inspires him to single handedly turn the tide against the Org. In the end, Danny's life doesn't allow them to be together.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Wild Force 10x21
episodes_data.description: Alyssa's father is in town, and calls Alyssa for lunch. Samurai Org stirs up trouble, and Alyssa must recall her father's training to defeat him.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Wild Force 10x22
episodes_data.description: To defeat Tombstone Org, who is powered by six Org spirits, the Rangers need the help of the Deer Zord. To get the Deer to help them, Shayla and Merrick must sing for him to make him happy again.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Wild Force 10x23
episodes_data.description: Nayzor is resurrected, stronger than ever, but he is defeated by Cole's new weapon, the Falcon Summoner, and destroyed as a giant by the Rangers' new Megazord the Isis Megazord featuring: the falcon, the deer, the giraffe, rhino and armadillo.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Wild Force 10x24
episodes_data.description: Wes and Eric track down three Mutorgs from the future to Turtle Cove, where they team up with the Wild Force rangers to battle them. The Rangers are greatly overpowered, and only with the intervention of Jen are they able to escape.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Wild Force 10x25
episodes_data.description: The other Time Force Rangers arrive from the future, bringing Ransik and Nadira with them. They track down the Mutorgs, and Ransik manages to destroy their mutant halves. This allows the 12 Rangers to destroy the trio.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Wild Force 10x26
episodes_data.description: Master Org kidnaps four of the Rangers, and reveals his true origin to Cole. In a heated battle, Cole destroys Master Org's Org half, reverting him back to a normal human. Meanwhile, Toxica and Jindrax have found a replacement to lead them - General Org Mandilok.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Wild Force 10x27
episodes_data.description:
Zen-Aku returns to rejoin with Merrick, and only by learning to accept help from his friends does Merrick defeat this evil from his past.

Note: This was the first episode to be shown on ABC Kids.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Wild Force 10x28
episodes_data.description: Cole befriends a mysterious young boy named Kite, who helps them defeat Mandilok's two new Duke Orgs - Artilla and Helicos.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Wild Force 10x29
episodes_data.description: A flute playing Org controls the citizens of Turtle Cove, and the Rangers, with his music. A surprising ally comes to their rescue - Animus.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Wild Force 10x30
episodes_data.description: Jindrax teams up with his brother to prove his worth by destroying the Rangers. After his brother is killed, Jindrax narrowly escapes.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Wild Force 10x31
episodes_data.description: The Rangers battle for control of the Wild Zords against Lion Tamer Org. The Zords are broken free of the Org's spell by Kite, who displays some mysterious powers.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Wild Force 10x32
episodes_data.description: Mandilok convinces Kite that humans are no good, and unleashes Monitor Org on them. Just as the Rangers defeat the Org, Kite reveals himself as Animus. He determines that humans do not deserve the Wild Zords' help, and takes them all away.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Wild Force 10x33
episodes_data.description: The Rangers struggle to defeat Toy Org without their Zords. When Animus truly believes in the soul of humanity, and the Rangers' commitment to protecting the Earth, he returns the Zords to the Rangers.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Wild Force 10x34
episodes_data.description: Ten Red Rangers from ten different teams unite to stop the Machine Empire from using Serpenterra to destroy Earth.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Wild Force 10x35
episodes_data.description: To prepare for his return, Master Org sends the ninja Duke Org Onikage to take care of business. Onikage succeeds in kidnapping Shayla and destroys Toxica.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Wild Force 10x36
episodes_data.description: Onikage creates Shadow Rangers to fight the Rangers. Master Org reappears and destroys Mandilok; Onikage is eventually destroyed by the Pegasus Megazord, but Master Org does manage to walk off with the Princess.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Wild Force 10x37
episodes_data.description: Jindrax sets up both the Rangers and the new Locomotive Org to re-energize Toxica's horn, which he uses to fish her out of the spirit world, Meanwhile, Master Org prepares the Nexus for a mysterious ceremony, and snatches Princess Shayla's necklace, for his ceremony.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Wild Force 10x38
episodes_data.description: The Rangers battle resurrected Org generals to disable the Nexus's force field, so that their new allies Toxica and Jindrax may sneak in and rescue Princess Shayla.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Wild Force 10x39
episodes_data.description: With no more villains to fight, the Rangers realize that their time as super heroes is finally at an end. Meanwhile, in the remains of the Nexus, a new threat emerges to threaten the Earth and the Animarium.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Wild Force 10x40
episodes_data.description: Master Org's destruction of nature continues unchecked while the Power Rangers fight a last desperate battle for the Earth. Good and evil collide in a final battle between the forces of Animaria and the Orgs.
